claim: Idaho's second AVA, Lewis-Clark Valley (2016), likewise straddles a state line, into Washington.
because: Idaho's second AVA is Eagle Foothills, established by TTB on 25 November 2015 as the first sub-AVA of Snake River Valley and the first AVA entirely inside Idaho. Lewis-Clark Valley came next, on 20 April 2016, as Idaho's third AVA.
fix: Idaho's second AVA, Eagle Foothills (2015), is a sub-AVA inside Snake River Valley; its third, Lewis-Clark Valley (2016), straddles the state line into Washington.
